title: Cassandra Raines
summary: The Reborn's public leader, known as the Voice, in Compromised's Gulf Coast conflict.

claims.text: Compromised identifies Cassandra Raines as the public leader of the Reborn and the speaker of the group's broadcasts.
In a broadcast, Raines announces that the Reborn will target the oil refinery in Groves because the group regards continued fossil-fuel production as unacceptable.
The novel depicts Raines being fatally betrayed during the rogue arms rendezvous on Marsh Island.

paragraphs.text: Raines presents herself as the Reborn's public voice and turns the Groves refinery into a symbolic target for the faction's anti-fossil-fuel campaign.

At Marsh Island, the relationship that supplied the Reborn with military material collapses violently. The novel treats Raines's death as the turning point that exposes the rogue network's manipulation.

verification.notes: The character and outcome are sourced solely to the licensed novel and are marked major spoiler.
